title: "Installation"

::: {.callout-note}
Demo page — for the authoritative, up-to-date install instructions for
every platform, see [rclone.org/install](https://rclone.org/install/).
:::

## Prerequisites

Just a terminal — rclone ships as a single self-contained binary, no
separate runtime required.

## Install

**Linux / macOS**, official install script:

```bash
sudo -v && curl https://rclone.org/install.sh | sudo bash
```

**Package managers** (may lag behind the latest release):

```bash
# Debian/Ubuntu
sudo apt install rclone

# Fedora
sudo dnf install rclone

# macOS (Homebrew)
brew install rclone
```

**Manual**: download the right archive for your platform from
[rclone.org/downloads](https://rclone.org/downloads/) and put the
`rclone` binary on your `PATH`.

## Verify

```bash
rclone version
```

Prints the installed version, OS/arch, and Go runtime version — if that
runs, you're ready for [Concepts](design.md) and the
[Command reference](reference.md).
